title: The Methods of Fire-Making
version: Report of the National Museum for 1890
lineage: Historical museum account reproducing S. B. J. Skertchly; source uses colonial language and speculative origin claims.

passages.note: Hough reproduces Skertchly’s 1890 account of a Bornean Dayak fire syringe as an example of compression-based fire making. The article contains colonial claims about Indigenous capabilities that are not adopted.
